Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning credit and debit card transactions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to credit and debit card transactions; and addinga new section to chapter 19.200 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.200 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Credit card" means a card or device existing for the purposeof obtaining money, goods, or services on credit. (b) "Customer" means any person who is or may be required to payfor goods or services. (c) "Debit card" means a card or device used to obtain money,goods, or services by a transaction that debits a cardholder's account,rather than extending credit. (d) "Seller" means any person who provides, offers to provide, orarranges for others to provide goods or services to a customer inexchange for consideration. (2) A seller may not require as a condition of payment by credit ordebit card that a customer: p. 1 HB 1534 (a) Consent to authorizing future charges against a customer'scredit or debit card that are separate from the sales transaction; or (b) Waive the right to expressly approve each charge that a sellercauses to be placed against a customer's credit or debit card.
